g.text: Only feature-relevant members are shown. The addShortfall parameter list is abbreviated.
Solid arrows show references with private role names; dashed arrows show dependencies or realization.
The parser's shared holder is an attribute; other references use association ends, never both.
Target-end multiplicities are shown; reverse ends are unspecified. Lists are ordered and nonunique.
The model allows empty lists; normal generation produces 1-7 days and 3 distinct recipes/day.
Integer targets may be null. RecipeBook is an execution parameter, not a stored command field.
